Select the option that substitutes the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

In any time of crisis, there is always one munent that stands out from all the others.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"munent"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "moment". (क्षण) 

 

 
• **Example: **There was a moment of silence before the applause erupted.

 

 

 
• **"Moment" **refers to a very brief period of time. (क्षण)

 

 
• **Example: **She paused for a moment to gather her thoughts before speaking.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.
